LanguageData.PhobosContract_InspectResting: {CARAVAN} is resting for the night; the work goes on in the morning.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StartWorkDesc: Start the work {SETTLEMENT} asked for: {REQUEST}. The caravan stays while it is done, and its truck burns its own fuel. Leaving stops the work; what is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StopWorkDesc: Stop the work at {SETTLEMENT}. What is done is kept, for this caravan or another to finish before the contract runs out.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_ShortFluid: The caravan's tanks hold {HAVE} of the {WANT} {UNIT} of {FLUID} asked for.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_ShortThings: The caravan carries {HAVE} of what was asked for: {REQUEST}.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoVehicle: No vehicle in the caravan can do this work.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoHand: Nobody in the caravan is fit to do the work: it needs someone able in {SKILL}.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoHandAny: Nobody in the caravan is fit to tend the work.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StoppedByOrder: The work at {SETTLEMENT} has stopped. What is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_Left: {CARAVAN} has left {SETTLEMENT}, so the work there has stopped. What is done is kept.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_HeldUp: The work at {SETTLEMENT} is held up: {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosContract_StrandedWords: Their {VEHICLE} has broken down: its {PART} is wrecked.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_CasualtyWords: {PERSON} was hurt on the road and cannot walk.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_HandOverDesc: Hand {TARGET} back to {SETTLEMENT}, as they asked.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_TargetLost: What they asked you to bring home is gone.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_NoVehicleWithIt: {TARGET} is not with this caravan: tow it here.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_LastVehicle: {TARGET} is this caravan's only vehicle: the caravan needs another to travel on.
LanguageData.PhobosContract_Mended: {TARGET} runs again, and its people drive it home to {SETTLEMENT}.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingContractFreq: Nearby settlements hire your vehicles: a load of chemfuel, water or stone, spare parts, or a truck's work at the settlement (a ground survey, a water bore, power for some days). The figure is how often, beside the game's own trade requests: 100% is as often as those, 0% offers none. A contract is offered only while you own a vehicle that can do it, and pays the game's usual quest rewards. Some wait at a place on the world map: a settlement's broken-down vehicle to tow home or mend, or one of its people hurt on the road to bring home.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingContractSite: Enemies may wait at contract sites

On: the place where a broken-down vehicle or a hurt traveller waits may hold enemies, mechanoids, turrets or angry animals, as the game's own rescue quests do (only where your storyteller allows violent quests). Off: those places are always quiet. Your people can die there, so it starts off.
